text:
jordan: Heads-up — PR #1224 updates the service-registry cache eviction behavior. Need to land this before the registry freeze (Mon Apr 4 18:00 UTC). CI is flaky: linux-x64 e2e-storage times out intermittently. Can someone trigger a rerun + quick review? @ravi @emily @linh

ravi: On it. I'll kick a rerun now and take a quick look if it passes. If it flakes we'll need to discuss a short rebase window.

ci-bot: CI rerun queued for PR #1224 — linux-x64 e2e-storage (queued). https://ci.redwood/example/1224

linh: I can take a look — ETA ~30m. Is this a safe one to merge during freeze if it passes? i.e., no schema/migration impact?

jordan: No schema changes — purely TTL/eviction logic and a guard to avoid evict-on-attach. Should be safe. Thinking of adding a release:non-deploy label so it won't trigger canary.

ops: That sounds right. If you add label "release:non-deploy" and set rollout=false in the manifest, ops won't push it into canary pipelines. Please add the label so the release team can ignore it.

emily: Can someone paste the failing log snippet? I want to sanity-check the failure pattern before a full review.

jordan: Log snippet: ```
ERROR: StorageClient timed out after 120s connecting to s3://reg-cache - attempt=3
  at StorageClient.request (storage/client.go:214)
  at registry.Cache.Fetch (registry/cache.go:87)
```

ravi: Rerun finished: one unrelated flake remains (integration/db-conn). I'll rerun that single job. If it passes I'll give approval.

ci-bot: Re-run started: integration/db-conn (attempt 2). https://ci.redwood/example/job/9876

emily: Quick code comment: rename `ttlOverride` -> `cacheTTL` for clarity. Rest looks fine to me. I'll approve once that's pushed and CI is green.

jordan: Pushed the rename (`git push --force-with-lease`). Small change only.

ravi: Reviewing now... LGTM, approving. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #1224. Merge executed by autobot. https://ci.redwood/example/pr/1224/merge

ops: Noted — since it's labeled non-deploy, it won't go to canary. We're still inside the registry-freeze prep window, so landing is fine. Thanks for moving fast. :tada:

emily: Thanks all. Good catch on the timeout pattern. If this resurfaces we should queue a follow-up to add a short circuit in StorageClient.

jordan: Agree. I'll open a follow-up issue and ping infra. Thanks everyone for quick turn-around. :pray:
